entries.65d6f8406c0d9722: This business manufactures and sells bearings for industrial machinery and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥347,067 million, a decrease of ¥5.2 billion (1.5%) from the previous year. Sales increased in North America and Asia, while the completion of the transfer of the needle roller bearing business in Europe is cited as the reason for the decline in revenue. The main regional breakdown is Japan ¥149,674 million, North America ¥93,566 million, Asia and Oceania ¥59,445 million and Europe ¥32,356 million (a 24.3% decrease from the previous year). In Vietnam, where demand for bearings is growing in the industrial machinery field and the aftermarket (for repair and retail), it has opened new aftermarket business bases in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City to strengthen its sales network. As of March 31, 2026, the number of employees was 11,344 (temporary employees, 1,022, are excluded from this figure). In Japan, the Kokubu Plant (Kashiwara, Osaka Prefecture) is a manufacturing facility solely for industrial machinery and bearings, and subsidiaries including JTEKT Sealing Techno Co., Ltd. (Aizumi, Itano District, Tokushima Prefecture), JTEKT Precision Bearing Co., Ltd. (Izumi, Osaka Prefecture), JTEKT Fine Tech Co., Ltd. (Utsunomiya, Tochigi Prefecture) and Jietai Gete Zhoucheng (Wuxi) Co., Ltd. (China) operate only in this segment. The group's major customer, [[company:toyota|TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION]] and its group companies, also record revenue in this segment.

entries.b203e473e69d32bf: A business that makes and sells steering and drivetrain parts for automakers, and the largest segment in the group. Two business segments, "Steering" and "Drivetrain", are combined into one because their economic characteristics, such as the trend in revenue, are similar. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,367,005 million, an increase of ¥33,854 million (2.5%) from the previous year. Sales decreased in Europe and China, but sales increased in Japan, North America and other regions, in addition to the effect of the weaker yen. The main breakdown by region is Japan ¥528,941 million, North America ¥323,088 million, and Asia and Oceania ¥321,131 million. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the steer-by-wire system "Syncusteer™", in which the steering unit and the turning unit are not mechanically connected, was installed in the "RZ", the first dedicated BEV model of LEXUS from [[company:toyota|TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION]]. In Europe it is advancing structural reform, and has announced a basic agreement on the transfer of its automotive business for European customers. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 is 25,915 (3,645 temporary employees, not included in this figure). In Japan, the Nara Plant (Kashihara, Nara), Hanazono Plant (Okazaki, Aichi), Toyohashi Plant (Toyohashi, Aichi) and Tadomisaki Plant (Takahama, Aichi) are manufacturing facilities for automotive products only. Among the subsidiaries, JTEKT Column System Co., Ltd. (Kosai, Shizuoka), JTEKT Gear System Co., Ltd. (Seto, Aichi), JTEKT Coating Co., Ltd. (Kariya, Aichi), JTEKT AUTOMOTIVE NORTH AMERICA, INC. (United States), JTEKT AUTOMOTIVE MEXICO, S.A. DE C.V. (Mexico), JTEKT INDIA LTD. (India), JTEKT EUROPE S.A.S. (France) and others operate only in this segment. The group's main customer is [[company:toyota|TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION]] and its group companies, for which revenue is recorded in all reportable segments; that revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥821,441 million. Sales to TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION alone were ¥408,556 million, equivalent to 21.2% of total sales.
